summary: All 13 hard checks passed, but the agent never called describe_endpoint on the create route, so it asserted that the video contract has no speech without checking the deployed schema.
agent_unsure: The GET /admin/video-generations?product_id=prod_cv01 call failed, so the agent could not confirm whether a generation already exists. It also assumed it could ask for the principal message and identity constraints in the same turn as the capability question.
